environment: isolated loopback PostgreSQL; uniquely created fixture actors/events; no DDL, product changes or shared pilot fixture edits
durability: Destination request, current ranking-authority approval and each own participant acceptance precede the first actual sporting start.
Premature event finalization is rejected and creates no event circuit source.
Stored actual visit actor identities prove every first throw; registrations and byes are not counted as additional starters.
Each real starter has one valid revision-one event source and one current generation booking; the two unstarted registrations have no source.
Identical-request retry and a fresh finalization request preserve the active generation, exact own history, rating row and source count.

existingSixteenStarterEvidence.testName: a complete sixteen-starter event crosses the real national field threshold exactly once
existingSixteenStarterEvidence.proven: 16 actual starters, 15 real sporting matches, national winner 10 points, source starter metadata exactly16

limits: Direct real server-command/read and database coverage; no HTTP browser/native or physical multi-device claim.
No complete acceptance row or original scenario status is marked passed.
